steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}). Verify you are signed in and report what page you land on.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' and open its work packages list. Find all work packages in that project whose subject starts with 'Seed:'. Report each of those subjects EXACTLY as displayed, one per line, and say how many there are. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In the project 'Bench Project', create a new work package of type 'Task' with the subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Fill any required fields, submit/save it, and report the work package's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (OpenProject shows it as #<number>) plus the URL of its detail page.

04-set: On the work package detail page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, set the Assignee field to the user named 'Bench Assignee'. This is an autocomplete field: click it, type the name, and actually select the 'Bench Assignee' option from the dropdown that appears so it is chosen, not merely typed. The field saves in place. Verify the Assignee now displays 'Bench Assignee' on the page and report exactly what it shows.

05-change: On the work package detail page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, change the Status field to 'In progress'. The status is edited in place (click it, pick the value from the dropdown, it saves on its own). Verify the Status now displays 'In progress' on the page and report exactly what it shows.

06-set: On the work package detail page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, set the Finish date field to 2026-12-31. The date is edited in place (click the Finish date field, enter the date, it saves on its own). Verify the Finish date now displays 2026-12-31 on the page and report exactly what it shows.

07-add: On the work package detail page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment, then verify it appears in the work package's activity/comments area and report the exact comment text shown and the author.

08-open: Open the work package detail page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id_displayed}} in Bench Project (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package'). Read and report the following facts from the page as displayed, without changing anything: (1) the work package ID shown as #<number>, (2) the subject, (3) the type, (4) the description text, (5) the Assignee, (6) the Status, (7) the Finish date, (8) whether the activity/comments area contains a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' and what that comment says.
